title: Bogus
description: A fake data generator for .NET that creates realistic test data on demand.

data.text: `Bogus` is a fake data generator that produces realistic, locale-aware test data. Unlike AutoFixture's random data, Bogus generates data that looks real, such as valid email addresses, names, addresses, and company information.
Create a `Faker<T>` to generate instances of your custom types with realistic data.

data.title: Basic Bogus Faker

data.text: Use `Generate(count)` to create multiple items. This is ideal for seeding databases in integration tests.

data.title: Generate Multiple Users
data.content: Create a list of fake users for test seeding.

terms.definition: A fluent builder that generates fake instances of type T.
Registers a rule that defines how a specific property is generated.
Produces one or many instances based on the configured rules.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Bogus supports many locales. Use `new Faker("fr")` to generate French names and addresses for internationalization tests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Bogus generates realistic, locale-aware fake data
Faker<T> uses RuleFor to configure property generation
Generate() creates single or multiple instances
Ideal for seeding test databases and integration tests
data.takeaway: Bogus produces more realistic test data than random generators, improving test reliability.
